reading:
Folio's line is loved for two things and sunk by the same five faults every round. Loved: the sommaire Home (every page a cell headed by a contents line: lamp, page number, name, dotted leader, count). Every lens called it "the best 'where is everything' device". Also loved: the question typed on the lit glass, a green summary tube on every page, and (since r13) the Fraunces figure-setting. Plans' month of big serif numerals is "the best-typeset page on the board", and the drive times ("2h10 min" with a raised h), calendar-leaf dates and fractions are what the type and style lenses want kept. What sank it (6.88, #9): 
(1) Tracked-mono-caps buttons. Every lens raised this, both rounds. 
(2) Equal cells stretched half-empty: Restaurants, Memory, Wishes, the idea cards, To do cards that wrap their titles. 
(3) 96px thin folios ("300", "990"), read as costume at 3.3:1. 
(4) No page names in the bar on Home and a second tab row elsewhere. 
(5) Filters and Add below the first screen, the chat input set in green VT323, and late not marked. 
Smaller faults: brass warmth and violet ideas ink pulling off-period, four faces, and screens that only repeat their cells. The tour's Switchboard, Settled Light shows the fix path. It rebuilt the same sommaire as two tiers (bigger Plans and To do, a household strip at the foot, a compact one-line setup notice, a scope beside the plan rows) and soul gave it 8 for light that lives only in the tubes. To win, Folio must keep its identity (numbered pages of one service, set as a contents page with facts printed large) and turn it into a system for daily reading. That means one-line rows to a Fraunces facts column, one numbered nav, sentence-case keys, cells sized to content, a NOW rail on every list in time, and the original phosphor light restored where the machine is: the lit key word, the tubes, the lamps, and a pool spilling onto the desk.

briefs.name: Folio, Railed Contents
briefs.hypothesis: Every judge already ranks the sommaire as the best map of the service and admires the figure-setting. What cost points was the rack's empty boxes, the caps keys, the costume folios and the hidden controls. Keep the contents-page idea and put Settled Light's two-tier map, Lit Manual's lit NOW rail and Departures' one-line table under it, all set in Folio's own Fraunces figures. The page should then read as a teletext magazine a family can scan in one glance: no dead cells, facts printed large where they are read, light only where the machine lives. That should lift it from 6.9 into the 7.5-8 band beside Settled Light and Joined, on a structure neither has.
briefs.brief:
Start from r13-wmut-1 (x14a-b/variants/r13-wmut-1/: sheet.css, templates/*). Keep: the numbered pages (100 Home, 200 Vera, 300 Ideas, 310 Restaurants, 400 Plans, 500 To do, 600 Wishes, 700 Memory, 800 Family, 900 Status, 990/991-999 Settings); the contents line as the one head drawing (lamp · number · name · dotted leader · figure); Fraunces figures in section inks; the plans_month.html month (keep it whole); a green tube on every page; the graphite ground (--bg #0a0d0c, --surface #121614).

SYSTEM AND TYPE
- Three faces with jobs. Fraunces (opsz on): titles, cell heads and figures only. IBM Plex Sans: body, rows, controls, labels; labels in `font-variant-caps: all-small-caps; letter-spacing: .04em`, replacing every Plex Mono label (`.eyebrow`, `.cell-label`, `.readout-label`). VT323: on glass only. Drop Plex Mono. Times and page numbers use Plex Sans with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.
- Steps: 13 (label), 15 (row meta), 17/600 (row title), 22 (cell head, Fraunces 600), 32 (page title, Fraunces 600, opsz 32), 40 (the greeting). Figures: 26-28px light Fraunces in rows and heads, 34px for the month's day numerals as now.
- Every control (`.btn`, `.key`, `.add`, `.inline-action`, Send, Earlier/Later, Add an idea, Tell Vera something, Connect the calendar) in sentence case, Plex Sans 600 15px, letter-spacing 0, min-height 44px.
- Folios: delete the 96px `.folio` / `.plate-art` numeral. Each inner page instead opens on ONE head row (`.page-head`, full width): 'P300' at 15px Plex Sans 600 tnum in the section ink (≥4.5:1) on the title's baseline, then the title in Fraunces 32px bone, then the page figure in Fraunces 28px section ink with its unit word in 13px small caps ('12 saved · 10 on the radar', '4 open · 3 late' with 'late' in amber as a link to the Late filter, '5 plans · next in 2 days'). The page's one green primary sits at the right ('Add an idea', 'Add something to do', 'Connect the calendar').

COLOUR
- --accent (brass #e3cd88) is retired from page numbers and initials. Page numbers take --faint (#8b958f) in rows and the section ink in the head row. Initials on Family/Wishes take bone --ink-2.
- --ideas moves from violet #bc97e8 to wheat #d4c08e (low chroma), so no violet remains. Keep plans sky #9ccdf8 and todo sea #83d5d4.
- Amber --people #eaa76b is reserved for late and needs-a-look only. The month's today cell is NOT amber: today's numeral is lit #6dff9c with the two-layer halo, plus a 1px green inset ring.
- Kind colours (shows, seasons, outing) live only in the 28px kind ring icon.
- Borders: one hairline --line on cells. A 2px section cap only on Home's cells and the current bar key.

NAV (one nav everywhere)
- Delete the `.tabs` row under the bar on inner pages. The bar holds Home, Vera, Ideas, Plans, To do, Wishes with icon, sentence-case name and its page number as a 12px tnum --faint suffix ('Ideas 300'), then a divider, then Memory, Family, Status, Settings. This applies on Home too. The current key gets the 2px section cap below and its number in the section ink. Keys are 44px tall.

HOME (templates/home.html: two tiers, the sommaire kept, `grid-auto-rows: min-content`, no cell taller than its content)
- Left, 5/12 wide: the terminal case `.ask`. On the glass, top first: the greeting 'What’s on for us?' in Fraunces 600 40px bone, with a true curly apostrophe. Only 'on' is lit #6dff9c with the kit's two-layer halo (text-shadow 0 0 2px, 0 0 10px at 55%, 0 0 28px at 25%) and the glass's scanlines over it. Directly under it is the box: Plex Sans 17px bone on a glass-tinted field (`--field` mixed with 8% screen), led by a lit '>' prompt glyph with its bloom. Then the From / Send where I am / mic / Send row, with Send the lit green primary. Then the three ways to start as full-width numbered keys ('1 What should we do this weekend?'), each with a 13px small-caps cross-reference at its right: 'see p400 Plans', 'see p500 To do', 'see p300 Ideas'. Then 'Continue with Vera p200 →'. The tube is sized to its content: no empty glass, and Next up leaves the tube. Under the case the terminal spills a 72px green pool onto the desk (radial-gradient, #6dff9c at 7%, fading).
- Right, 7/12: first and widest, `.setup-cell` becomes one compact contents line: 'Finish setting up ……… 3 left' with an amber 3px left bar (no amber outline), then one line: 'Next: Choose your own password → then Telegram, then Google Calendar', and a key 'All 3 steps'.
- Under it, Plans 400 (a step larger): a contents-line head ('400 Plans ……… 4 coming'). A small square scope (the existing radar, 170px) sits at the left with marks numbered by day. Beside it the plan rows hang from a vertical steel rail with one lit NOW lamp at the top. Each row: Fraunces 30px day numeral in sky with stacked 'Sun / Oct' small caps, title 17/600, time tnum, 'in 2 days' (the nearest in bone, the others dim). The first row IS Next up. Caption: 'Google Calendar is not connected…'.
- Then To do 500: head '500 To do ……… 4 open · 3 late'. One-line rows on the same rail: the rail dot amber for late, then the lit NOW tick between late and the rest. Each row: 44px checkbox, title, Who column, due words ('was due 5 days ago' in amber). Late is worked out in the template (`row.due_input` against today, as figure-refine's `_ui.html` `today_iso`/`day_state` do), not passed by the view.
- Left under the case: Ideas 300 as one-line rows to a facts column (kind ring · title · for · kind word), plus a final row '310 Restaurants · 2 to try →' that folds the empty Restaurants cell in, and 'Add an idea'.
- Foot: the household strip, five contents lines across: 600 Wishes '0 open' (Maya 0 · Theo 0), 700 Memory → (Tell Vera something), 800 Family '4 people' (Sam · Alex · Maya · Theo), 900 Status '1 of 3 on' (lamps: Telegram off, Calendar off), 990 Settings '9 parts' (amber lamp + 'Sign-in and security'). Each head has a lamp. One lamp breathes, Answering's, rebuilt from L225: white-hot core in a breathing halo that never goes out. Off is a pewter ring, never a red ring. The Memory and Wishes cells disappear as boxes.

INNER PAGES (one rack: head row; then a sticky 20rem left column holding the page's tube; then the main column with its controls FIRST, then one-line rows)
- Each tube must say what the rows do not. Ideas: the radar with '10 of 12 on the radar', nearest and furthest. To do: an ASCII tally on glass, 'LATE ███ 3 / THIS WEEK 0 / LATER 0 / NO DATE 1'. Plans: 'Next in 2 days · Oaks Park 13:00' with a countdown. Status: today's spend against the limit, with a limit tick and a ghost peak. Settings: '1 needs a look'. Chat: her screen. Tubes keep the kit's scanlines, bloom, warm-up from a line, and corner vignette, at full strength.
- Ideas (ideas.html): at the top of the main column, Search plus the kind keys as latched one-tap keys (All · Activity · Restaurant · Outing · Trip …) and Restaurants 310. Then a contents table, one row per idea (min 48px): '#1' tnum faint · title 17/600 · kind ring + word · For · By road as a Fraunces 26px figure, right-aligned in a facts column with the raised h kept ('2ʰ10 min') · Way as 'S' in an `<abbr title="south">` (drop the arrows). The idea cards go.
- To do (tasks.html): Show as a segmented key row Open · Late 3 · Done · Cancelled · All, plus Search, above the list. Rows hang from a rail: date leaf at the left in Fraunces 22px + small caps month ('27 Sep'), rail dot (amber late), checkbox, title, who, due words, 'Edit' at the right. The lit NOW line is 2px #6dff9c with the E1 halo, running from the rail across the row hairline between late and the rest. The task cards go.
- Plans list (plans.html): the same rail with day numerals. Plans month: keep, cell boxes to hairlines, today lit as above.
- Chat (chat.html): the input in Plex Sans on the glass-tinted field with the lit '>'. On the phone the thread comes first.
- Status and Settings: rows as contents lines (lamp · 991 · name · leader · state). Settings sorts 'Needs a look' first.

LIGHT (phosphor_kit.md): bright #6dff9c only on the mark, the lit 'on', the '>' glyph, Send and the primary keys, focus rings (2px + 6px halo, the select included), lamps, NOW lines, the month's today, and the tubes. Row hover: a 12% steel wash with a 2px sage left edge that decays over 1s as afterglow (visible in stills while hovered). Everything else is matte ink.

PHONE (home-phone): the case, the setup line, Plans, To do, Ideas, then the household as two columns. Starters stacked full width. 0 targets under 44px.

GIVES UP: the equal-cell rack on Home, Next up inside the Home tube, the 96px folios, the idea and task cards, the second tab row, Plex Mono, brass and violet.
briefs.borrows:
OWN JUDGES' FIXES, most cited first:
(1) Sentence-case Plex Sans 600 keys, no tracked mono caps: all eight lenses, both rounds (feedback, soul, style, system, interaction, type, usability, skeptic).
(2) Cells sized to content, so the empty Memory, Restaurants, Wishes and idea cards collapse into rows (grid-auto-rows:min-content): feedback, soul, style, system, interaction, skeptic.
(3) Folios cut from 96px to a small 4.5:1 page number on the head row: system (48px quieter), type (64px or 4.5:1), skeptic (small or drop).
(4) Page names in the bar on Home, and one nav: feedback, interaction, usability, skeptic.
(5) One-line rows to a right facts column for Ideas and To do: system, feedback, type, skeptic.
(6) Search and filters, and To do's Add and Show, on the first screen: interaction, usability.
(7) Chat input in Plex on a glass-tinted field: interaction, usability.
(8) Late in amber: style, interaction, usability.
(9) Three faces, Plex small caps replacing Plex Mono: style.
(10) Brass quieted: soul, feedback, and lessons.md.
(11) Each tube says what its cells do not: soul, and lessons.md.
(12) 'south' after the compass: usability.
(13) The question and box at the top of the glass, setup first and widest: interaction.

FROM THE TOUR:
(a) Settled Light's two-tier sommaire. That means the household strip of contents lines with figures and one line each across the foot, Plans and To do a step larger, the small scope beside the plan rows it numbers, and setup as a compact one-line 'Next:' notice. Source: t3-switchboard-refine, x14a-a/variants/t3-switchboard-refine/templates/home.html (the `.household` section, ~line 227) and sheet.css; shot x14a-a/out/t3-switchboard-refine/shots/home.png. Rebuilt with Folio's page numbers and Fraunces figures.
(b) Lit Manual's rail with one lit NOW per list in time, the Late filter key, and late worked out in the template. Source: t3-figure-refine, x14a-a/variants/t3-figure-refine/templates/tasks.html (rail_mark, now_rule, ~lines 95-156) and templates/_ui.html (today_iso, day_state, rail_mark, now_rule); shot x14a-a/out/t3-figure-refine/shots/todo.png. Rebuilt with Fraunces date leaves on the rail.
(c) Departures, Platformed's one-line Ideas table (By road / Way columns, filters above the list) and its 'usually Plans' starter notes. Source: t3-timetable-refine, x14a-a/variants/t3-timetable-refine/templates/ideas.html (colheads `dest-grid`, ~line 106) and templates/home.html; shot x14a-a/out/t3-timetable-refine/shots/ideas.png. Rebuilt as Folio's own cross-references ('see p400 Plans') and its raised-h Fraunces drive figures.

FROM THE LEDGER: L225, the white-hot lamp core in a halo that breathes but never goes out. Source: r11-mut-4 Track Diagram Relit, harness/rounds/r11/variants/r11-mut-4/src/phosphor.css (--hot, --lamp-core, --lamp-glow, --lamp-low, @keyframes lamp). Used on the contents-line lamps, with one breathing per view.
briefs.avoids:
- The tracked-caps keys, raised by every lens.
- Half-empty stretched cells: Memory, Restaurants, Wishes, the idea cards, the Status plate.
- 96px low-contrast folios read as costume (system, type, skeptic, and lessons.md 'not rewarded').
- No page names in the bar on Home, and two navs (interaction, usability, skeptic).
- Filters and Add below the first screen (interaction, usability).
- VT323 for the typed field (interaction, usability).
- To do cards wrapping their titles, and no late marking.
- Four faces (style).
- The brass warm cast and the violet ideas ink (feedback, skeptic, and lessons.md's off-period violet).
- Tubes that only repeat their cells (soul).
- The amber today cell, where amber was doing two jobs.
- The tall-tick VT323 apostrophe, now a Fraunces curly ’ at 40px.
- The owner's 'lost the unique effect', answered by restoring the halo'd key word, full-strength tubes, breathing lamps, the green pool under the terminal, and a visible row afterglow, while everything the family keeps stays matte.
briefs.title: What’s *on* for us? It is not yet tried. 'What's on' is the teletext page every videotex service had, the listings page, so the title is this line's own idea and also FamilyDB's job: what is on the family's calendar, list and wishes. 'For us' makes it the household's question, which judges preferred over 'your mind'. The lit word 'on' doubles as a lamp's ON, so the glow means what the machine says. At 17 characters it holds one line on a phone at 40px. It replaces the line's carried 'What’s on your mind?', which every titles judge faulted as a therapist's prompt.
